verdict.rationale: The axis applies, and Pilot keeps your books in QuickBooks: you keep your existing QuickBooks account and historical data, and any tax preparer can work with it. That gives some practical portability and freedom to leave. It is not documented export of all your data in open formats, and QuickBooks is a proprietary platform. Missing for 10: an explicit data-export feature, open or standard export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), coverage of portal and other non-QuickBooks data, documented offboarding terms, and independent confirmation of a clean exit.
